title: Runbook: diagnosing and fixing integration test timeout
body:
# Runbook: integration test timeout
Typical symptoms: test fails with SocketTimeoutException (read timed out after 30000ms) while connecting to db during the integration-tests stage.
Common root cause: The test DB connection pool is exhausted under parallel test load, so new connections block past the 30s timeout.
Standard resolution: Increase the HikariCP pool size to 20, or run the integration suite with --threads 1 to serialize DB access; add a connection-acquire retry with backoff.
Escalate to the owning team if the standard resolution does not clear it within 30 minutes.

title: Runbook: diagnosing and fixing dependency not found
body:
# Runbook: dependency not found
Typical symptoms: The build stage fails with 'Could not resolve dependency artifact:version; latest in artifactory is prev'.
Common root cause: The pom/build file pins {artifact} to {version}, a version that was never published to artifactory.
Standard resolution: Pin artifact back to prev, or publish version to artifactory; then re-run the build.
Escalate to the owning team if the standard resolution does not clear it within 30 minutes.

title: Runbook: diagnosing and fixing oom kill
body:
# Runbook: oom kill
Typical symptoms: The service pod is OOMKilled during the stage stage; kubelet reports memory limit exceeded (peak > memGi).
Common root cause: The container memory limit is set below the working-set needed to process the current dataset size.
Standard resolution: Raise the container memory limit to newmemGi and set -Xmx to 75% of it; enable heap-dump-on-OOM to confirm.
Escalate to the owning team if the standard resolution does not clear it within 30 minutes.

title: Runbook: diagnosing and fixing flaky test
body:
# Runbook: flaky test
Typical symptoms: test passes locally but fails ~15% of CI runs with an assertion on unexpected ordering.
Common root cause: A race condition: the test asserts on results before an async write has completed.
Standard resolution: Await the async completion (or poll with a deadline) before asserting; remove the fixed sleep and use awaitility.
Escalate to the owning team if the standard resolution does not clear it within 30 minutes.

title: Runbook: diagnosing and fixing cert expiry
body:
# Runbook: cert expiry
Typical symptoms: Outbound calls from service fail with 'certificate expired' / PKIX path validation errors starting date.
Common root cause: The client mTLS certificate expired and was not rotated ahead of its expiry.
Standard resolution: Rotate the mTLS certificate, redeploy the secret, and add an alert 30 days before cert expiry to prevent recurrence.
Escalate to the owning team if the standard resolution does not clear it within 30 minutes.

title: Runbook: diagnosing and fixing disk full
body:
# Runbook: disk full
Typical symptoms: The stage stage fails with 'No space left on device' on the CI runner.
Common root cause: The build artifact and Docker layer cache filled the runner's disk; nothing prunes it.
Standard resolution: Add a cache-pruning step (docker system prune, clear ~/.m2 older than 7d) and increase the runner disk to diskGB.
Escalate to the owning team if the standard resolution does not clear it within 30 minutes.

title: Runbook: diagnosing and fixing deploy readiness
body:
# Runbook: deploy readiness
Typical symptoms: The deploy-staging stage for service times out; the pod never becomes Ready and rolls back.
Common root cause: The readiness probe's initialDelaySeconds is shorter than the service's real startup time, so it's marked unhealthy too early.
Standard resolution: Increase the readiness probe initialDelaySeconds to delays and add a startupProbe so slow starts aren't killed.
Escalate to the owning team if the standard resolution does not clear it within 30 minutes.

title: Runbook: diagnosing and fixing kafka lag
body:
# Runbook: kafka lag
Typical symptoms: Consumer lag on topic topic spikes into the millions; service falls behind and alerts fire.
Common root cause: Partition key skew concentrates traffic on a few partitions, so a subset of consumers is saturated.
Standard resolution: Rebalance by increasing partitions to parts and choosing a higher-cardinality partition key; scale the consumer group.
Escalate to the owning team if the standard resolution does not clear it within 30 minutes.

title: Runbook: diagnosing and fixing config missing
body:
# Runbook: config missing
Typical symptoms: service crash-loops on startup with 'required property key is not set'.
Common root cause: A new required env var {key} was added in code but not added to the deployment's config map.
Standard resolution: Add key to the config map / secret for every environment and redeploy; add a startup config-validation check.
Escalate to the owning team if the standard resolution does not clear it within 30 minutes.

title: Runbook: diagnosing and fixing rate limit
body:
# Runbook: rate limit
Typical symptoms: service sees a surge of HTTP 429 responses from dep, causing cascading request failures.
Common root cause: No client-side rate limiting or backoff, so retries amplify load past the {dep} quota.
Standard resolution: Add token-bucket client rate limiting and exponential backoff with jitter; request a higher dep quota if needed.
Escalate to the owning team if the standard resolution does not clear it within 30 minutes.
